card.name: Separators inside symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas and linking words (or, abdominal) inside a list of general symptoms such as malaise, myalgias, abdominal pain, shortness of breath. Strongest in the metformin lactic acidosis symptom list.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom
modes.description: A comma between items in a list of nonspecific symptoms.
modes.example: accompanied only by nonspecific symptoms such as malaise<<,>> myalgias, respiratory distress, som

modes.label: Linking word in a symptom list
modes.description: The word or, or an adjective like abdominal, partway through a symptom list.
modes.example: Symptoms of COVID-19 may include fever or chills, cough, shortness of breath<< or>> difficulty breathing, fatigue, muscle or body

card.writes: Little clear effect; it mildly suppresses blood-related words, so the next item is not predicted to be about blood or bleeding.
card.plain: It fires at the commas and 'or' that separate symptoms in a list of general complaints like malaise and muscle pain.
